audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds' and never says what Fate Sealed does.
audit.why: Fate Sealed (120s at rank 1 down to 80s, 1000 range) blinks him BEHIND the last champion in a line and drags everyone it caught toward him. Standing at the back of your own group is what gets you hit, and the entry never says so.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names both ultimates and states the behind-the-last-target blink.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Cleave's shield is never mentioned, and the entry never gives Soul Unbound's real cooldown.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave (W, flat 14s, 700 range) shields him, and the shield grows with the number of champions the cone catches — so poking him through his own wave is what feeds it, and you have to force the shield out before you commit your burst rather than after. Its cooldown also scales with his attack speed, so it gets shorter as he itemises. Soul Unbound (E) starts at 22s and falls to 10s by rank 5: the snap-back window the entry builds its level-6 plan around more than halves over the lane.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt on Spirit Cleave's shield and Soul Unbound's 22s-to-10s scaling.
